gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Commanding in its wide stance, Goldman sets round, parenthesis-like forms above Noto Sans Lao Looped, whose bowls stay open on one side. Text settles into solid blocks.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Goldman's lowercase stands unusually tall next to its capitals, with generous clearance between every letter. Noto Sans Lepcha follows in sans-serif form, its curves wide open and its small letters stout as cast iron, so paragraphs feel sturdy yet approachable.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu reads in tall-bodied small letters whose curves gape open, approachable and contemporary. Against Goldman's wide, parenthesis-round display forms, Noto Sans Limbu is the more human voice, and that gap is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu reads in a plain sans manner, with wide-open s curves and ascenders that stop just shy of the x-height line. Noto Sans Lisu keeps paragraphs moving smoothly under Goldman's bold, widely spaced heading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Big, brash and spread out, Goldman leads, while Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase. Noto Sans Lydian then reads like an easy, open sans, its curves sprung wide as a paper clip.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Goldman brings wide, commanding display letters, with a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Noto Sans Mahajani, a modern sans with funnel-wide e throats, would feel cramped if the heading shrank too small beside it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Wide, bold and a bit blunt, Goldman leads with round forms like open parentheses above Noto Sans Malayalam, a sans-serif whose middle zone dominates each line. Its s curves stay generous, so text flows comfortably.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Goldman's lowercase towers over its capitals, spaced wide and bold. Goldman is the one to make announcements, while Noto Sans Mandaic is better at the quieter work, with its curvy, unclamped letters rising close to capital height.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen stands proud, its small letters almost capital-sized and curves ending in clear daylight, under Goldman's bold, wide-set heading. Paragraphs in it feel clean and unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numera: Goldman's lowercase towers over its capitals, spaced wide. Under that commanding display voice, Noto Sans Mayan Numerals adds tall-bodied small letters and a c that gapes at any size, a modern, professional counterweight.
